opts: 依刑法第16條，甲除有正當理由而無法避免，不得因不知法律而免除刑事責任，故甲仍成立通姦罪
依刑法第26條，甲之行為既不能發生通姦罪之結果，又無危險，故屬通姦罪之不能犯，不罰
依刑法第25條，甲主觀上具通姦犯意，客觀上已著手實行而不遂，成立通姦罪之未遂犯

mcq.q: Why is urban air mobility becoming more popular according to this passage?
opts: Long runways are a necessity for its operational requirements.
Its extremely slow pace poses no harm to the natural environment.
It ironically causes more pollution than both cars and buses combined.
Technology is improving and people want fast and eco-friendly travel options.
mcq.passage: Urban air mobility is like a big change in how we move around crowded cities. Instead of just cars and buses, we are talking about flying taxis and other cool ways to get around in the air. This new way of traveling is becoming more popular because technology is getting better, and people want ways to travel that are fast and good for the environment. Basically, urban air mobility uses small electric planes that can take off and land vertically. Unlike regular planes that need long runways, these planes are small and quiet, which is great for cities. One big reason why people are excited about urban air mobility is because it can help ease traffic jams and reduce pollution in cities. These flying planes can skip all the traffic on the ground and take people where they need to go really quickly. Plus, they do not make much pollution, so they are better for the environment. Urban air mobility is not just about moving people around—it could also change how cities are built and planned. By adding flying transportation to cities, we can make it easier for people to get around, especially in places where there are not many options for getting around on the ground. Flying planes could be used for lots of things, like helping in emergencies, delivering packages, or moving things around the city. They are pretty versatile and can be useful in all sorts of situations. But there are some challenges to making urban air mobility a reality. We need rules and plans for how these planes can fly safely in cities, and we need to make sure there are places for them to take off and land. In the end, urban air mobility could change how we travel in cities, making it faster, cleaner, and easier to get around. Even though there is still work to do, it seems like flying taxis could be part of our everyday lives sooner than we think.
